steps.note: The plan states that the first rows subtract J a + R c, that rows 2-7 add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx) and restore c,a, and that the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of a,c.
S1.1.3 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, says the side injection cancels the intersection-one cases with zero and two already zero, and gives self coefficient one.
S1.1.4 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, says the side cancels intersections zero and two, and says intersection one contributes zero, matching the paper.
S1.1.5 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with the inverse schedule in the middle stage, and says every scratch wire is restored.

The plan defines the orthogonal residual in general (S1.3.1) and says every edge joins comparable labels (S1.4.1.1), but it never gives the per-edge residuals or their dimensions from the residual table.
S1.3.5 states only the inclusion P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (quoting line 953); the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 that defines the 2->5 residual is missing.
The plan says the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 with loss h, that signed changes telescope at gates, that sources sum to N and sinks to Wm-N giving Wm-2N, and that absolute values add 2L.

S1.6.0 states that every nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating (it contains a norm-one vector) and therefore has an orthonormal basis, quoting line 1087; the plane-absorption detail is not spelled out.
S1.4.2 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.
The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors, or the formula q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis.
S1.6.1 asserts the result (a product of kernels aI+bX_v) without the odd-weight phase i^{eps[v.x]} or the H diag(1,-1) H = X conversion that derives it.
The plan never says that on k columns each residual vector contributes one tensored factor, giving s_c factors; S1.6.2 counts basis lengths only for a single column.

S1.6.3 and S1.6.4 name the exceptional pair, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates, Z-repair via C=iZC^{-1}Z and undoing the signed exchange, but omit the endpoint frames (I for the zero label, C^{(x)m} for the full label) and the Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after placement; they assert C^{(x)m} by telescoping without those endpoints, so I mark this absent as the unsure case.
The plan says both loss ratios are below 1/2 and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s_b<W_b m (and likewise for c).
S2.2.6.1 mentions eta_b only as exceeding 20*2^{-50}, without its exact value 339/22587335000000.
The value eta_c = 73/19906842167500 is never stated; it is only mentioned alongside eta_b in S2.2.6.1.
The plan states that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and that log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
The plan gives the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations, repetition on the active indices, and exactly a ones in Pi.
The plan works over Z/q^b but never states that a fixed odd prime q is chosen to avoid every denominator in a finite table of factors so the triangular factors stay invertible.
S2.1.2 says a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order.
S2.1.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the swap, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, and S2.1.5 gives one interchange each, a in all.

S3.5 gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, C_1=20 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), but it never defines C_0=128mB^2 or nu, or says C_1=max{20,nu+3}; with this many constants missing, I mark it absent as the unsure case.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with A(e)<=8e at leaves, and the per-invocation count below E, do not appear in the plan.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, the bound A(e)<=8B^2d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are absent; S3.5 only asserts the final bound.

S3.5 says growth is bounded by Delta, which is o(p) since eps C_1<1, but it omits the depth-ell size invariant (2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i], modulus <=2^ell) and the reservation of p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits.
S3.6 says every row of H has absolute row sum one, so the disk is preserved and the single final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P03 covers the bank-exchange network fully (B1-B4) and covers most of the label-dimension bookkeeping (L3-L5), but it omits the residual table and the h-2 side-edge complement. It gives the matrix shear except for the choice of the prime (M2), and the rank saving except for the exact eta values (R2, R3). It asserts the complex-phase interface's results without their derivations (P1-P4 absent). For the simultaneous layer it states only the constants E, B and C_1 and the final row-sum truncation (S5), leaving out the depth recurrence, its unrolling and the bit-reservation argument. 13 of 26 are present.
